Prodigy Chiro Care: Where Your Health Is Our Priority

Come get proper care with experienced Chiropractic Doctors with over 20 years of experience at Prodigy Chiro Care and Spinal Decompression. We have 4 convenient locations through out the West side: Marina Del Rey, Santa Monica, Los Angeles, and Culver City. Our dedicated team uses a diverse range of services to address your unique needs and conditions:

Book your Online Appt today and start your journey to a healthier you!

Our Services:
Chiropractic Adjustments
Spinal Decompression

Custom Foot Orthotics

Our Promise:
Patient-centered care: We listen, collaborate, and tailor our approach to you.
Gentle and effective techniques: Evidence-based methods for your comfort.
Clear communication: We explain complex concepts simply and keep you informed.
Collaborative approach: We work with other healthcare providers for your well-being.

Contact us today for your personalized consultation!
